zotero.abstractNote: MAMMA is a novel markerless motion-capture pipeline that recovers SMPL-X parameters from multi-view videos of multi-person interaction. Our approach consists of MammaNet, a novel transformer-based dense landmark estimator that predicts 2D surface landmarks, uncertainty, visibility, and contact probabilities. Our network learns per-landmark embeddings which help it handle complex and out-of-distribution poses. To train this network, we introduce MammaSyn, a large-scale synthetic dataset featuring complex multi-person interactions and ground-truth dense landmarks. Finally, MAMMA uses the predicted 2D landmarks to optimise the SMPL-X parameters, leveraging the predicted uncertainty, visibility and contact information.
